name: adapt_reactive_config_c_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time greeter.c's own text contains 'Hello' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt) instead of a fixed prompt count, then config.h's NAME macro changes under it
prompts: config.h defines a macro NAME (a string literal). Create greeter.c that #includes "config.h" and defines `const char *greet(void)` returning "Hello, " NAME "!" using string literal concatenation with the NAME macro - do not hardcode the greeting as a separate literal string.
config.h's NAME macro may have changed since you last checked it. Make sure greet() still returns a string built from the CURRENT value of NAME, not a stale or hardcoded one.

disruptions.description: config.h's NAME macro changed World -> Universe, triggered reactively once greeter.c's first draft appeared (not a fixed step count)

test_setup_files.test_greeter.py:
import subprocess
subprocess.run(['gcc', 'greeter.c', 'test_greeter.c', '-o', 'greeter_bin'], check=True)
proc = subprocess.run(['./greeter_bin'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
assert proc.returncode == 0, f'exit {proc.returncode}, stderr={proc.stderr!r}'
assert 'PASS' in proc.stdout, f'unexpected output: {proc.stdout!r}'
print('PASS')
